1. Take the intensity of the image and its color ratios.
2. Build the Gaussian pyramid of the intensity.
3. For each sampled value of g, remap the intensity around it and build its Laplacian pyramid.
4. For each coefficient, interpolate between the two pyramids whose g values bracket the Gaussian pyramid value.
5. Keep the coarsest level of the Gaussian pyramid, and collapse the pyramid.
6. Put the color back with the ratios.
